text.text_excerpt: This place housed a lot of hot sauces! I enjoy the various kinds and broad selection. It is also just a fun stopping tour spot. There are a few where you have to sign a waiver to try it out!

Hot Sauce Galore: We are hunters of the hottest hot sauces, and would love to find a bottle that could keep us coming back for more. We stumbled across this shop as we were exploring the French Quarter. It's a tasting bar for all things spicy. They have boxes of tortilla chips in which you can dip into the various hot sauces along the isles to try for your liking. Beware, things can heat up pretty quickly. My husband's forehead started to perspirate after the third tasting. We ended up purchasing the Reaper Hot Sauce [roughly $28 per bottle]. Really neat to learn about the differences in hot sauces (i.e., where the peppers were raised, ingredients that attribute to its uniqueness, etc.). ...

This is a must-stop shop for me anytime I'm in the quarter. They have a wonderful selection including both locally-made and nationally-known sauces. Being able to sample each is a treat; I always stock up because quite a few of these I cannot find back home. Try some sauces by HongryHawg - they're based in Louisiana and have a lot of good ones. There is another tasting bar style shop in the French Quarter, but they only sell their own brand (which isn't bad to be fair). House of Pepper has the best variety and selection though - accept no substitutions, fellow spicelords!!
